notes.name: Tactics
notes.effect:
Sharpks hunt in pairs. First they armor up by locking their armor into place with Bulwark, then they use Speedscrape to knock their foes out of their boats, before tearing helpless victims in the water to shreds with their Finblades.

When a Sharpk enters Crisis it gets much stronger as it goes turbo, and it's partner encourages them by using Shine and Dine, sharpening their blade with its own until either it enters crisis itself, or it runs out of MP. When they are both in crisis they take turns using Shine and Dine on each other between attacks until they are out of MP.

When the first Sharpk dies, the other should ascend into a villain, immediately spending a newly gained Ultima Point to flee, returning later in the campaign as a Lockjaw.

BQ8tsg3j3aix6UJlFewv.description:
Sharpks are monsters that naturally grow a steel-like metallic coating that never rusts, making it's sharpened fin blades and armored plates very valuable! They're inherently magical creatures, conjuring swift currents that jet propel them through the water.

They enjoy hunting birds and sailors, and do so by raising their central fin above the water and moving at extreme speed, then they tilt, the angle of their bladed fin creating a jet of water that knocks people off ships or birds into the water where they are promptly sliced up into bite sized chunks.

Sharpks mate for life, and so hunt in pairs turning into vicious killers. Usually one of them focuses on knocking their prey into the water while the other focuses on being the first to slice and dice them. When one of the pair dies, it's said that a Sharpk without love will continue to hunt enough food for two, but will eat both portions. This causes the Sharpk to grow to massive sizes, it's armor to crack in places, harming the protective coating that keeps it's steel from corroding, causing it to rust. These Sharpks tend to be much more aggressive, taking bites out of prey before they are even killed by their razor fins, and once it bites into you it will never let go. This behavior has lead sailors to fearfully refer to these kind of Sharpks as "Lockjaws"

CHQgsGlGryzv9Gqwjkhe.description: His mother died during childbirth. Soon after, so did his father and brother. Anyone who tried to enter the house where he was born died until a traveling mage who happened to be in the village took him in, sensing the aura of death from him. He forbade him from approaching normal people and raised him as his son. He began learning magic from him. One of the mage's acquaintances taught him how to raise corpses, and so young Kanafis (as the mage called him) made his first friends. Unfortunately, as he became a teenager, his Will grew even more powerful, killing his adoptive father, then resurrecting him as an unthinking corpse. Kanafis sank into despair and sought help from Kamaran, the god of death. Unfortunately, Kamaran, at that time, was primarily a concept spreading death and was used by Diablo as a tool. The young necromancer became their puppet for centuries, spreading terror and murdering the populace. Only later did he regain some control over himself and learn to block his aura. Kamaran also stabilized his domain enough to oppose Diablo by causing the souls of the slain to be reborn into undead creatures created by Kanafis. Thus was born an empire of darkness, where the war was primarily fought within a single, solitary soul.
